findings.scientific_consequence: The universal disjointness condition would invalidate the reviewed H230 samefold teacher/student training design without evidence of held-out leakage, and would force unnecessary cross-fit work. Shared permitted fitting groups remain a scientific provenance attribute and may affect target quality; they are not themselves evidence of evaluation contamination.

findings.scientific_consequence: Padding the raw 211 input does not change cuDNN's recurrent input_size; it cannot remove a GRU alignment fallback blamed on 211. It only changes the preceding input Linear GEMM reduction dimension and must be treated as a distinct measured dispatch hypothesis.
